Thank you for your help. Unfortunately I am not allowed to send you the data, but I have created some simulated data that is close. Hopefully this will help. I can send the log file as well if that helps.

BTW, on re-running the model with the more common response the same thing has happened now, so that theory is broken.

BW

Duncan

#Generate the data
dih <- rbinom(100000, 1, 0.1)
z.age <- rnorm(100000, 0, 1)
male <- factor(rbinom(100000, 1, 0.4))
amb <- factor(rbinom(100000, 1, 0.4))
init <- factor(rbinom(100000, 1, 0.4))
no <- factor(rbinom(100000, 1, 0.006))
prev <- factor(rbinom(100000, 1, 0.2))
vd <- factor(rbinom(100000, 1, 0.4))
any <- factor(rbinom(100000, 1, 0.1))
smoke <- factor(rbinom(100000, 1, 0.1))
lip <- factor(rbinom(100000, 1, 0.15))
htn <- factor(rbinom(100000, 1, 0.2))
quarter <- round(runif(100000, 1, 20), 0)
tsa <- round(runif(100000, 1, 133), 0)
cases <- data.frame(dih, z.age, male, amb, init, no, prev, vd, any, smoke, lip, htn, quarter, tsa)

#generate the duplicate and correctly labelled variables, ensuring that all combinations are included
pasteTQ <- function(x, y) {
  paste(formatC(x, width=3, flag=0), formatC(y, width=2, flag=0), "tq", sep=".")
}
cases$tsa.qu <- with(cases, pasteTQ(tsa, quarter))
cases$tsa <- with(cases, paste(formatC(tsa, width=3, flag=0), "t", sep=""))
cases$tsa <- factor(cases$tsa)
all.combs <- data.frame(tsa.qu = as.vector(outer(unique(cases$tsa), unique(cases$quarter), FUN="pasteTQ")), stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
cases <- merge(cases, all.combs, by="tsa.qu", all=TRUE, sort=FALSE)

#fill in any rows that have been created
cases[is.na(cases$tsa),"tsa"] <- paste(substr(cases[is.na(cases$tsa),"tsa.qu"], 1, 3), "t", sep="")
cases[is.na(cases$quarter),"quarter"] <- as.integer(substr(cases[is.na(cases$quarter),"tsa.qu"], 5, 6))
cases$quarter1 <- cases$quarter
cases$tsa.qu <- factor(cases$tsa.qu)
cases[is.na(cases$dih), 3:13] <- 0

#get the graph in the correct format
library(igraph)
graph <- get.adjacency(erdos.renyi.game(133, 351, "gnm"), "both")
colnames(graph) <-  sort(unique(cases$tsa))
rownames(graph) <-  sort(unique(cases$tsa))

#create and run the model
library(INLA)
formula <- dih ~ 1 + z.age+male+amb+init+no+prev+vd+any+smoke+lip+htn + f(tsa, model="bym", graph=graph, values=colnames(graph)) + f(quarter1) + f(quarter, model="rw1") + f(tsa.qu)

lc.time <- inla.make.lincombs(quarter=diag(20), quarter1=diag(20))
modD <- inla(formula, family="binomial", data=cases, control.compute=list(dic=TRUE), control.predictor=list(link=1), lincomb=lc.time)
